component-o.sku-note-s: one SKU per ANY-OUT setting: 1.6V (pin 11), 800mV (pin 10) and 100mV (pin 6) to GND, the other program pins open -> VOUT = 0.8 + 1.6 + 0.8 + 0.1 = 3.30 V (Table 9-3 p29); the public 5 V -> 3.3 V / 0.3 A demo at 1 % (33 mV on a full 0.3 A step), where the TLV62569 buck could not meet 0.11 ohm
component-o.description-s: 2 A low-noise (8.9 uVrms at 3.3 V), high-PSRR LDO, ANY-OUT strapped to 3.30 V, VIN 1.4-6.5 V (1.1 V with BIAS), 200 mV dropout at 2 A, +/-1 % over line/load/temperature, power-good, soft-start, VQFN-20 5 x 5 mm (RGW)

cfgpins-ao.14c: EN high (VIH 1.1 V min) enables, low (VIL 0.5 V max) disables; if enable is not needed, connect to IN or BIAS (Pin Functions p4, EC p7): tied to VIN

cfgpins-ao.2c: SNS connects the internal R1 to the output: to the load side of the output trace when ANY-OUT is used (Pin Functions p5)

cfgpins-ao.3c: CFF 10 nF FB to OUT, 'not required' but maximizes ac performance (Pin Functions p4; ROC CFF 10 nF nom p6); the noise and PSRR specifications use CFF = 10 nF (p8); TI notes a CFF may disturb PG at start-up

cfgpins-ao.12c: BIAS not used (VIN >= 1.4 V): left floating or tied to ground (Pin Functions p4): tied to GND

cfgpins-ao.4c: PG open drain, active high when VOUT reaches VIT(PG) 88 % typ; RPG 10-100 kOhm (ROC p6): 100 kOhm to VIN as in the EC conditions

cfgpins-ao.11c: ANY-OUT: 1.6V, 800mV and 100mV program pins to GND, all others open -> 0.8 V + 1.6 V + 0.8 V + 0.1 V = 3.30 V (Equation 2 p28, Table 9-3 p29)

cfgpins-ao.5c: unused ANY-OUT pins are left floating (open) (Pin Functions p4)

noise_source-o.fig-s: Figure 7-9. Output Voltage Noise vs Output Voltage, IOUT = 2 A: 8.36 uVrms at 3.0 V and 9.45 uVrms at 3.6 V (procurement pdf-graph), 8.9 uVrms at 3.3 V by linear interpolation; EC p8: 4.4 uVrms at 0.8 V, 7.7 uVrms at 5.0 V (10 Hz-100 kHz, CNR/SS 100 nF, CFF 10 nF)

load_transient-ao.read-s: read from the rendered page (300 dpi, by eye): right axis 10 mV/div (5.0 px/mV); the VOUT trace spikes to -40 mV at the 50 ms rise and +40 mV at the 236 ms release, settling about -3 mV then +2 mV; current trace about 0.15 -> 1.93 A
load_transient-ao.vout_note-s: measured at 5 V out; TI shows no 3.3 V capture. The 0.8 V capture (Figure 7-16) gives -30 / +38 mV for about the same step, so the response barely depends on VOUT; at 3.3 V about 40 mV / 1.78 A = 22 milliohm effective, and about 7 mV for a 0.3 A step (scaled linearly, an estimate)

load_transient-ao.vout_note-s: measured at 0.8 V out; TI shows no 3.3 V capture
